title: dbt Cloud Run Queue Time
dataSources: dbt Cloud Admin API runs (`dbtcloud:run`), Discovery API, and dbt artifacts (`dbt:run_results`, `dbt:manifest`).
app: dbt Cloud Admin API (`/api/v2/accounts/{id}/runs`) and Metadata (Discovery) API via HEC scripted inputs; dbt run artifacts (`run_results.json`, `manifest.json`) forwarded as `dbt:run_results`.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=dbtcloud:run
| eval queue_s=coalesce(queued_seconds, duration_queued)
| stats avg(queue_s) as avg_q, p95(queue_s) as p95_q by job_name
| eval p95_min=round(p95_q/60,1)
| where p95_min>5
| sort - p95_min
description: Measures how long dbt Cloud runs wait in the queue before an available run slot picks them up, revealing account-level concurrency limits.
value: Queue time eats into pipeline windows and is invisible in job duration; surfacing it justifies more run slots or better scheduling.
implementation: Extract queued seconds from the runs API; schedule daily and alert when queue time crosses your tolerance.
visualization: Table of job by p95 queue time, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how long dbt jobs wait their turn before running so you can add capacity before they start finishing late.
